about.title: About
about.subtitle: A bit about me
about.description:
I'm Eduardo, a mobile and full stack developer. I currently lead two React Native apps for healthtech startups: HC Hospital Care, which connects patients to professionals for home care and is already submitted to the stores awaiting release, and SpeedMed, a clinic management system.

I started with Flutter. I delivered a desktop app for managing courts and tabs to a real client, with Windows, Linux and macOS builds, and I maintain my own apps that I use daily, like Radar Manhua and Dark Harmony.

Day to day, I write Angular and Spring Boot on Propag and React with TypeScript on SPAs, and I've been a Product Owner handling roadmap and backlog. I like deciding the architecture, reviewing code and following a feature until it reaches the user.
